title: Tandjiria embankment, clay fill, water-filled crack

meta.title: Tandjiria embankment, clay fill, water-filled crack
meta.notes: Half-embankment (9 m crest, 10 m wide crest, 1V:1.67H face) of clay fill (Su = 20 kPa) on soft clay (Su = 20 kPa), γ = 19.4; 2 m water-filled tension crack, unreinforced; circular search. Also run with the automatic (Rankine) crack depth.

source.reference: Tandjiria, V., Low, B.K. & Teh, C.I. (2002). Effect of reinforcement force distribution on stability of embankments. Geotextiles and Geomembranes 20, 423–443.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V086b (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: program D gives 0.968 on the reference circle, as cSlope does; Tandjiria 0.981.

This is commercial program A's version (face 1V:1.67H, 2 m crack). Tandjiria et al. give a 30° face (1V:1.732H, p. 431, Fig. 4) and a water-filled crack 2c/γ = 2.06 m deep (Table 2 note); their 0.981 is checked on that input in V086d. Their soft-clay unit weight is not printed; 19.4 here and 20 in V086c are assumptions (docs/kallor/tandjiria-low-teh-2002.md).
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
grieta de tracción: profundidad 2 m, fracción de agua 1 (cSlope tensionCrackDepth y tensionCrackWater); en ogs es `analysis.tension_crack {depth, water_fill}` (F5.2).
